svg.title: How IBM Concert's six modules fit together
svg.desc: Three pairs of modules on one line. Observe and Operate: full-stack observability, and alerts correlated, grouped and deduplicated across domains. Optimize and Protect: resource use matched to application demand, and exposures weighed for exploitability. Resilience and Workflows: signals connected for resilience, and low-code workflows that run governed action.
